findings: Complete ten-gap passage follows folding, ordering, sewing, trimming and covering; defined nouns prevent a book-part swap.

Unused adhesive, brittle, grain, vertically and woven were tested against all slots; each fails an explicit definition, chronology or required grammar.

questionAudits.finding: bringing one half over other直接定义folded折叠。trimmed是裁边、pierced为穿孔，aligned为对齐，均不表示对折动作；woven是编织而非纸半边翻覆。
文中明确给成组折页命名signatures书帖。binding为装订整体，margins是空白边，cover是封面，grain为纸纹；其余不指这些待缝的复数组。
in pencil from first to last及detect missing leaf要求依次编号numbered。folded/trimmed/pierced不产生首尾序号，aligned只排齐；其他词不作该被动编号动作。
edges brought into same line定义aligned对齐。trimmed为切齐但此步只放齐，后文才裁边；folded为折叠，pierced穿孔，woven编织，均非所述位置调整。
make small holes needed for thread定义pierced穿孔。trimmed是裁去边缘、folded是折，aligned对齐，woven编织不适用于造针孔；其他候选不表该动作。
too much pulling force与too little定义线张力tension。binding是装订结构，grain纸纹，adhesive胶、margins留白，均非线的拉力；其他项词性或含义不合。
held pages together的完成装订为binding。cover此时未附，后段才做保护外层；signatures是被装订的组，adhesive在本案例缝线工序非主体，tension是力而非结构。
cut uneven outer edges、neat outline要求trimmed修裁。pierced只打孔，folded折页，aligned摆齐，woven编织均不切掉边缘；其他词不作该切边被动。
blank spaces around writing直接定义margins页边留白。cover外壳、binding装订、grain纸纹不表文字周围空白；signatures为折页组，其他词非此复数名词。
protective且attached around pages、outside指cover封面。binding是页组连接非后附外罩，signatures为内页，adhesive是胶不作为整块尺寸核对保护层；其他候选不指外封。

findings: All parts and actions are defined verbally; no diagram or external repair knowledge is needed.
Slider and teeth cannot be interchanged; interlock describes joining, separated the opening result, reversible the repeatability of that operation.
Caught is anchored by trapped, gently by low force, aligned by the starting position and lubricate by reduced friction.
Unused consistently, fragile, patent, woven and yield were checked against the restored text. Product-dependent care is preserved rather than offering one repair method for every zip.
unresolvedConcerns: Author semantic/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher review or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: small projecting pieces in two rows为teeth拉链齿。slider是单一滑块非复数突出件；strain是受力、patent专利不指此部件，其他候选非该复数名词。
held by pull tab、guides rows的移动件定义slider滑块。teeth为两排齿，不是拉片握持的单一导件；patent是权利、strain为力，其他项不命名该部件。
fitting together so rows hold定义interlock咬合。yield为让步或屈服，与两排相互扣住不同；lubricate为润滑，不能与one another在此表示齿咬合；其他候选非该复数主语原形动作。
no longer joined直接说明separated分离。aligned只说排齐，不等于解开；caught为卡住，woven为织在一起，均不表示反方向打开的结果；reversible只是可逆特性。
undone and repeated without destroying定义reversible可逆。fragile为易损不等于可反复撤销；woven表编织，aligned位置对齐，其他词不命名这一过程性质。
unnecessary strain及force may damage定义过大应力。patent为专利，slider为实体部件，teeth为齿，不是施加于拉链的力；其他项非该受力名词。
trapped where should not be定义caught夹住。woven指本来织成，aligned说对齐、separated分开都不是织物误卡在滑块；fragile虽可形容织物却不解释trapped。
carefully and little force直接释义gently轻柔。consistently表一致地，不能表低力度，且与阻碍处理关系不如后置定义；其余候选不作该动作方式副词。
positioned correctly in relation定义aligned对齐。separated只分离、caught卡住、woven织造都不等于正确起始匹配；reversible说过程可逆而非两起始端位置。
reducing friction by more slippery定义lubricate润滑。interlock咬合不等于减摩、yield屈服，均不指涂合宜物质减小接触摩擦；其他词非recommend substance to后的该原形动作。

findings: Authorship attribution, autograph status, chronology and provenance have separate explicit definitions; none substitutes for another merely because all concern a manuscript.
Revisions do not prove the reviser was the original composer. Copies and revisions occupy different grammatical and documentary roles.
Stylistic analysis is limited to musical language, corroboration to independent support and conjectural to the unestablished inference.
Unused annotation, distinctive, independently, recurrent and unequivocal were checked against every gap; unequivocal conflicts directly with the stated uncertainty.
Gap3 was tightened with the explicit gloss duplicate transcriptions so revisions cannot compete locally as another surviving version.
unresolvedConcerns: Author semantic/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher review or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: assignment of authorship明确定义attribution署名归属。annotation为注释、chronology年代顺序、provenance保管来源、corroboration佐证都不直接等于把作品归给某作者。
score in composer’s own hand定义autograph作曲者亲笔谱。copies为复数抄本，annotation注记、attribution归属都不是以an开头的亲笔文献名；其他候选不符合此释义。
Other handwritten加复数及duplicate transcriptions直接定义copies抄本。revisions是改动，不等同此处定义的重复誊写文本；第4空另由划去替换明确占用revisions。其他候选抽象单数或词性不合，不能指这些完整抄谱。
crossed-out passages and replacement notes为revisions修改。copies指多份文献不是一稿内部划改，annotation虽可指注释但此处复数形式不匹配且非删除替换；其他名词不命名改稿动作。
their order in time定义chronology时序。provenance是所有和保管历史，attribution作者判断、corroboration佐证、annotation注释均非文献先后序。
history ownership and custody定义provenance来源流转。chronology纯先后、attribution作者归属都不完整表达谁持有如何入馆；annotation/corroboration不指保管沿革。
concerned with style rather than handwriting定义stylistic风格分析。distinctive只是独特、recurrent反复、conjectural推测、unequivocal明确，都不说明研究对象为风格；副词不作此描述补语。
supporting with evidence another source说明corroboration佐证。attribution是待支持判断，provenance流转史，annotation注记、chronology年代序都不直接指独立印证。
informed supposition rather than established fact直接定义conjectural推测性的。unequivocal与未确事实冲突，distinctive独特、recurrent反复、stylistic风格均不表达证据尚属推测。
from person or collection to another及circulation指transmitted传递流转。revisions为名词、copies也是名词；其他候选不作have been后的这一被动传递分词，independently副词不能单作谓语。

findings: The fictional budgeting convention defines denomination, conversion and settlement rather than relying on specialist accounting rules.
Forecast and expenditure distinguish estimates from amounts paid; realised savings are distinguished from merely favourable quoted rates.
Volatility is fluctuation rather than appreciation alone. Hedging is explicitly limited by contract scope and is not presented as eliminating every uncertainty.
Nominal is defined against constant purchasing power; retrospectively describes later review without rewriting earlier uncertainty.
Unused accrual, appreciation, liabilities, speculative and yielded were checked in the complete passage; none supplies the defined slot under the stated grammar.
unresolvedConcerns: Author semantic/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher review or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: monetary unit in which figure expressed定义denomination币种单位。appreciation为升值、liabilities为负债、expenditure支出、accrual应计，均不指表中每数值用的货币单位。
every price into grant currency说明converted换算。hedged为对冲风险，未必将每项报价按一率换算；yielded为产生不搭此货币转换，realised为实现收益而非所有价格换币，其他非此过去式。
completion payment to supplier直接定义settlement结算。forecast是预测、accrual应计不是付款完成、volatility波动、appreciation升值，均不等同供应商款项交付完成。
future costs、estimate rather than already paid定义forecast预测。expenditure为已花支出与未付相反，liabilities负债不等于预计总成本，denomination单位不是未来估算。
tendency rate fluctuate定义volatility波动性。appreciation只升值单向不是上下变动性质，settlement为结算、accrual为应计、forecast为预测均非波动性。
currency exposure through rate-fixing contract说明hedged对冲。converted是按当前率换算不保证锁未来，realised是收益已实现不指风险合约，yielded产生不表达保护敞口；其他词非过去式操作。
actually when exchange completed与expected对照，realised已实现。converted指换算且以saving为宾语会换其表示货币而非确认兑现，hedged为对冲不是兑现节省，其他词不作该实际实现的过去分词。
money spent by project定义expenditure支出。liabilities为所欠负债不必已付，forecast为尚估，settlement为单次结算过程非总体花销类别；其他名词不指此已用资金记录。
current money without constant purchasing-power adjustment定义nominal名义数额。speculative为投机或推测，不说明未作购买力调整；realised说收益兑现也非金额口径，其他词不作该货币比较性质形容词。
looking back with outcome明确定义retrospectively回顾地。其余候选无回顾方式副词；不能以speculative形容词替代修饰reviewed的时间视角，其他名动词均词性不合。
